column1: # Two app slots so firmware updates can be applied safely with rollback.
# nvs_key holds the XTS keys for NVS encryption (Part B / SECURE_BOOT.md).
# It is included now — unused and inert while flash encryption is off — so
# the layout is identical before and after enabling security
# turning on Secure Boot never forces a repartition that would wipe NVS.
# Placed at the end of flash so it is independent of the partition-table
# offset (which may need to move when the signed bootloader grows).
